overview_description.description:
O7 Therapy is revolutionizing access to mental health services through a digital platform and mobile app offering online therapy, psycho-educational resources, and corporate wellness programs, to empower Arabic-speaking people to pursue their mental wellness journey.
We use cutting edge AI in a very engaging user experience producing an effective therapeutic journey.  

Additionally, we provide Employee Wellness Programs for organizations through a unique B2B2E model, prioritizing the impact of mental health challenges in the workplace, and focusing on raising awareness and understanding, reducing stigma and shame, creating safe and supportive spaces, and implementing strategies that promote mental wellbeing.

product.name: Online Therapy Platform
product.description: A digital platform and mobile app providing access to licensed therapists for online mental health therapy sessions.

product.name: Rassel Text-Line
product.description: An on-demand mental health text-based chat service providing access to wellness supporters without scheduling.

product.name: Online Group Therapy
product.description: Virtual group therapy sessions led by licensed therapists to provide shared mental health support and skill development.

product.name: Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) Skills Groups
product.description: Structured online DBT group sessions teaching skills for emotional regulation, mindfulness, distress tolerance, and interpersonal effectiveness.

product.name: Mental Health Assessments
product.description: Medically reviewed online assessments providing personalized feedback on various mental health aspects.

product.name: Employee Wellness Program
product.description: A comprehensive mental health benefits program for organizations, including therapy, text support, workshops, and wellness initiatives.
